about: The iOS connectivity and reliability matrix: one row per cell. `suite` names where it runs (rust: cmux-next-ios/rust `cargo test --workspace` on Linux; ios: CmuxMobileKit on the iOS simulator). `test` is the test's name as its runner prints it. `gate: true` cells fail the workflow (and so block a PR); `gate: false` cells are reported, and turned to true once they pass; each says why in `reason`. `ios-ui` cells are XCUITests of the app (cmux-next-ios/UITests), run on the fleet simulator route. Every cell asserts some of: reconnected within N seconds, no lost or duplicated messages, the list shown from cache meanwhile, a clear state shown, and (degenerate) the god variant within 1.2x of the small one. Axis `device` holds the window shapes and changes a session lives through (iPhone, iPad, a foldable folded, unfolded and folded mid-session, Dynamic Type AX5, dark, rotation, low memory); axis `growth` runs each core operation to N=10 and N=200 after warm-up and bounds memory and disk growth per operation. Pattern page: cmuxterm-hq docs/handbook/patterns/ios-connectivity-matrix.md.

cells.case: offline, then back (10 s and 8 h)
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 2 s after the network is back; 'Reconnecting…' meanwhile; backoff; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: network back while a retry dial hangs on the dead path
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 2 s after the network is back; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: network back with no path change (captive portal, VPN)
cells.asserts: reconnect <= longest backoff step + one dial

cells.case: Wi-Fi to cellular handoff (machine)
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 1 s; never 'Offline'

cells.case: Wi-Fi to cellular handoff (WireGuard roam mid-stream)
cells.asserts: no data lost, no stall

cells.case: airplane mode, then back (tunnel)
cells.asserts: stream resumes, no data lost

cells.case: 3 s outage while the Mac produces 10 vs 20,000 deltas
cells.asserts: every delta once and in order; link stays up; fresh list within 1.2x of the small backlog

cells.case: 3 s outage, 20,000 deltas, phone applies 1 ms per delta
cells.asserts: no delta lost; link up; fresh list within 1.2x of the small backlog

cells.case: 160 ms RTT, 3% of chunks stall 250 ms; 1 vs 1,000 workspaces
cells.asserts: list < 5 s; 1,000 within 1.2x of 1

cells.case: UDP blocked (captive or corporate network)
cells.asserts: link up over TURN/TLS on 443

cells.case: roam onto a network that blocks UDP
cells.asserts: stream continues over TURN/TLS

cells.case: every service with UDP blocked
cells.asserts: every service answers

cells.case: UDP-blocked mode redials once
cells.asserts: one redial, connected over TURN/TLS

cells.case: distant network (relay only)
cells.asserts: link up over TURN

cells.case: signaling socket replaced under a live session
cells.asserts: session continues

cells.case: background 1 min and 8 h, then active
cells.asserts: stale link replaced within one dial; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: resume with a silently dead link (controller)
cells.asserts: redial at once, no probe first

cells.case: link dies silently while in the foreground
cells.asserts: redialed within the 5 s budget

cells.case: killed and relaunched
cells.asserts: dial at once; 'Reconnecting…' never 'Offline'

cells.case: list shown from cache at launch
cells.asserts: cached rows shown before the Mac answers

cells.case: list kept from cache when a refresh fails
cells.asserts: cached rows kept

cells.case: memory warning while connected
cells.asserts: memory given back; link untouched

cells.case: Mac asleep 1 min and 8 h (presence offline), then wakes
cells.asserts: 'Offline', no dials while asleep; reconnect within one dial; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: Mac network asleep before its presence; wakes
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 2 s after wake; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: Mac asleep under a live link (silent stream)
cells.asserts: link reports closed within keepalive + timeout

cells.case: Mac wakes with a blackholed signaling socket
cells.asserts: signaling replaced, phone dial and echo complete

cells.case: Mac app (cmux-mobile-host) restarts under a live link
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 2 s after the host is back; never 'Offline'

cells.case: daemon (cmux-tui) restarts; 1 vs 5,000 workspaces
cells.asserts: open channel closes clearly; clear refusal while down; list < 1 s after; god within 1.2x

cells.case: Cloud VM paused and resumed
cells.asserts: connect after resume

cells.case: session list of 1, 100, 1,000 and 5,000
cells.asserts: whole and correct; 100+ within 1.2x of 1

cells.case: keystroke while 8 MB of tool output streams
cells.asserts: output whole and in order; keystroke RTT within 1.2x of 1 KB

cells.case: open another session while 8 MB of tool output streams
cells.asserts: first reply within 1.2x of 1 KB

cells.case: iphone (402 x 874 pt, compact width)
cells.asserts: list rows inside the window; an open workspace's composer on screen

cells.case: ipad (820 x 1180 pt, regular width and height; the app is iPhone-only and a real iPad runs it in compatibility mode)
cells.asserts: list rows inside the window; composer on screen

cells.case: foldable-folded (cover screen 344 x 882 pt, compact width; no iPhone Duo simulator: emulated as the window size and horizontal size class a fold gives the app)
cells.asserts: list rows inside the window; composer on screen

cells.case: foldable-unfolded (inner screen 884 x 1104 pt, regular width)
cells.asserts: list rows inside the window; composer on screen

cells.case: fold-mid-session (folded, unfolded, folded: compact to regular width and back)
cells.asserts: the open workspace, the list's top row and the composer's text survive each fold; layout holds at each size

cells.case: dynamic-type-ax5 (accessibilityExtraExtraExtraLarge, window traits)
cells.asserts: rows grow with the text (> 1.5x Large) and stay inside the window; composer on screen

cells.case: dynamic-type-ax5, the app launched with -UIPreferredContentSizeCategoryName UICTContentSizeCategoryAccessibilityXXXL
cells.asserts: rows fit the window; a tap opens a workspace
cells.reason: XCUITest of the app: GitHub CI builds the kit, not the app; runs on the fleet simulator route (scripts/ci/cmux-next-ios-sim.sh test ui=DeviceAxesUITests)

cells.case: dark (window style dark)
cells.asserts: list and composer take the dark appearance; layout as in light

cells.case: dark, the app launched with Appearance set to Dark
cells.asserts: the screen is dark (mean luminance < 0.35)
cells.reason: XCUITest of the app: GitHub CI builds the kit, not the app; runs on the fleet simulator route (scripts/ci/cmux-next-ios-sim.sh test ui=DeviceAxesUITests)

cells.case: rotation (portrait, landscape with compact height, portrait; window traits)
cells.asserts: the open workspace, the list's top row and the composer's text survive; layout holds

cells.case: rotation, the app turned with XCUIDevice orientation
cells.asserts: the list keeps its rows and the open workspace stays open
cells.reason: XCUITest of the app: GitHub CI builds the kit, not the app; runs on the fleet simulator route (scripts/ci/cmux-next-ios-sim.sh test ui=DeviceAxesUITests)

cells.case: low-memory (a memory warning mid-reconnect)
cells.asserts: the warning is handled; the in-flight redial completes; no extra dial; the old link closed

cells.case: open and close a session (dial, connect, close)
cells.asserts: after 10 warm-up ops: phys_footprint <= 8 MiB and the app's folders <= 64 KiB more at N=200; <= 4 KiB and 64 B per op from N=10 to N=200

cells.case: reconnect (the link drops, a redial connects)
cells.asserts: after 10 warm-up ops: phys_footprint <= 8 MiB and the app's folders <= 64 KiB more at N=200; <= 4 KiB and 64 B per op from N=10 to N=200

cells.case: network change under a live link (settle, roam, no redial)
cells.asserts: after 10 warm-up ops: phys_footprint <= 8 MiB and the app's folders <= 64 KiB more at N=200; <= 4 KiB and 64 B per op from N=10 to N=200; no redial

cells.case: switch workspace (its page's source built, a tab activated)
cells.asserts: after 10 warm-up ops: phys_footprint <= 8 MiB and the app's folders <= 64 KiB more at N=200; <= 4 KiB and 64 B per op from N=10 to N=200

cells.case: receive 1,000 deltas from the Mac's daemon
cells.asserts: after 10 warm-up ops: phys_footprint <= 8 MiB and the app's folders <= 64 KiB more at N=200; <= 4 KiB and 64 B per op from N=10 to N=200
cells.reason: known red: memory grows about 12 bytes per applied delta (2.2 MB at N=200, ~11.9 KB per 1,000-delta op), not attributed yet: cmuxterm-hq#8975

cells.case: open a chat with long output (300 turns), spill its older turns, close it
cells.asserts: after 10 warm-up ops: phys_footprint <= 8 MiB and the app's folders <= 64 KiB more at N=200; <= 4 KiB and 64 B per op from N=10 to N=200; the spill is deleted at close

cells.case: first pairing (scanned code)
cells.asserts: the Mac app is asked

cells.case: a token alone opens nothing
cells.asserts: no service before approval

cells.case: expired access token
cells.asserts: silent retry with a fresh token

cells.case: phone the person refused (host side)
cells.asserts: closed 'denied'

cells.case: phone refused or revoked on the Mac (phone side)
cells.asserts: stops asking; waits for the person

cells.case: session revoked (no access token can be minted)
cells.asserts: 'Signed out' after one refresh, not 'Reconnecting…' forever; no dial

cells.case: session revoked (the service refuses the token at the dial, the refreshed one too)
cells.asserts: 'Signed out' after one refresh; no event dials again

cells.case: a signed-out Mac's link closed as idle, then shown again
cells.asserts: still 'Signed out'; no redial until a new sign-in

cells.case: the service refuses the token at the signaling upgrade (Rust link)
cells.asserts: Refused 'unauthorized' for WireGuard and WebRTC
